source_sentence: Given that we know that BERT is a contextual encoder, and that its self-attention uses the vector norm to control the levels of contribution from less informative words , we suspect that this gives it the capabilities to accurately model these short-distance dependencies and word co-occurrence probabilities, concepts which strongly correspond to local contextual incongruity.
